name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
steps: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs and your palms facing you.
Pull your elbows out and up to shoulder height with forearms hanging vertically at right angles.
Keep your elbows bent and rotate your upper arms until your hands point up, then press overhead.
Lower to the bent-elbow position, rotate your forearms down, and return the dumbbells to your thighs.
tips: Limit the rotation to the range you can control with your ribs stacked over your hips.
Keep your elbows steady at shoulder height during the rotation instead of letting them drop.
